text: Tivoli Carvoeiro is a five-star resort on the cliffs just east of Carvoeiro, and the nearest course, the 9-hole par-3 [Vale de Milho](/courses/vale-de-milho), is about **5 minutes** away. Pestana's two Carvoeiro courses, [Vale da Pinta](/courses/vale-da-pinta) and [Gramacho](/courses/gramacho), are about 14 to 15 minutes away, and Pestana Ferragudo, Silves, Amendoeira and Penina are all within about half an hour. **Last checked: November 2026.**

Green fees are the lowest and highest standard visitor rates for the 2026/27 season, from each club's own online booking or price list, for the holes shown. The 18-hole courses ask for a handicap certificate, usually up to 28 for men and 36 for ladies. Pestana's website gives 27 and 35 for Gramacho and Vale da Pinta. Vale de Milho and the Penina Resort Course don't ask for one.

text: The nearest courses at a glance
Slope ratings are from the Portuguese Golf Federation for the back tees: the higher the number, the harder the course for an average golfer.
**[Vale de Milho](/courses/vale-de-milho)** (9 holes, par 27, 926 m): a short par-3 course in Carvoeiro, €22 a round, with no handicap needed.
**[Vale da Pinta](/courses/vale-da-pinta)** (par 71, 6,127 m, slope 132): Pestana's Carvoeiro course with rolling fairways. Twilight is €55 from 3.30pm.
**[Gramacho](/courses/gramacho)** (par 72, 6,107 m, slope 132): Pestana's hillier Carvoeiro course, next to Vale da Pinta. Twilight is €55 from 3.30pm.
**[Pestana Ferragudo](/courses/pestana-ferragudo)** (par 72, 5,841 m, slope 118): Pestana's newest course, opened in 2026, and one of the easiest 18-hole courses in the area on slope.
**[Silves](/courses/silves)** (par 70, 5,592 m, slope 120): a shorter, gentler Pestana course among orchards, with more slopes on the back nine, where a buggy is recommended.

**[Amendoeira Faldo](/courses/amendoeira-faldo)** (par 72, 6,598 m, slope 142): Nick Faldo's course climbs the hillside and is one of the hardest in the area. The online green fee includes a buggy, if one is available.

**[Amendoeira O'Connor](/courses/amendoeira-oconnor)** (par 72, 6,708 m, slope 136): Christy O'Connor Jr.'s sister course stays flat in the valley among orange groves, with the same buggy-included green fee.

**[Penina Championship](/courses/penina-championship)** (par 73, 6,273 m, slope 143): Cotton's 1966 course, the first in the Algarve, which the club says has hosted the Portuguese Open ten times. Flat, but the hardest course in the area on slope.
Golf at Tivoli Carvoeiro

The hotel has a golf page on its official website, which says it offers guests discounts at most of the Algarve's golf courses and can arrange tee times. We couldn't read the page in full, so ask the hotel which courses the discounts cover and how they work when you book.

For the rest of the day, the resort sits on the clifftop above the sea, and Carvoeiro's beach and restaurants are close by. See [hotels near Pestana Carvoeiro golf](/guide/hotels-near-pestana-carvoeiro-golf) for other places to stay nearby.

perks: Golf discounts and tee-time booking (ask for details)

text: Which course to play from Tivoli Carvoeiro

**For the closest 18 holes,** Vale da Pinta and Gramacho are about a quarter of an hour away. Read [Gramacho vs Vale da Pinta](/guide/gramacho-vs-vale-da-pinta-which-pestana-carvoeiro-course-should-you-play).
**For a quick or beginner-friendly round,** Vale de Milho is 5 minutes away, costs €22 and doesn't ask for a handicap.

**For a challenge,** Amendoeira Faldo and Penina Championship have the highest slopes in the area. Compare [Amendoeira Faldo and O'Connor](/guide/amendoeira-faldo-vs-o-connor-which-silves-golf-course-should-you-play).
Getting there

Tivoli Carvoeiro is about **60 minutes and 67 km from Faro Airport** by car, without traffic. See [Faro Airport to Carvoeiro and Silves for golfers](/guide/faro-airport-to-carvoeiro-and-silves-for-golfers).
Golf near Tivoli Carvoeiro: common questions
What is the closest golf course to Tivoli Carvoeiro?
Vale de Milho, a 9-hole par-3 course about 5 minutes away. The closest 18-hole courses are Vale da Pinta and Gramacho, about 14 to 15 minutes away.
Does Tivoli Carvoeiro offer golf discounts?
Its website says guests get discounts at most of the Algarve's golf courses and that the hotel can arrange tee times. Ask for the details when you book.
Do I need a handicap to play near Tivoli Carvoeiro?

At the 18-hole courses, yes, usually up to 28 for men and 36 for ladies. Vale de Milho doesn't ask for one. See [do you need a handicap to play golf in the Algarve?](/guide/do-you-need-a-handicap-to-play-golf-in-the-algarve)
